purpose: Server-timed replay screen of two p95-tail hypotheses on 360 s church clips; production defaults unchanged; no visible-ACK, human-quality or default-promotion claim.
interpreter: venv/bin/python (promoted Torch 2.13.0 / TorchAudio 2.11.0 environment) for every run
fixed_argv: --profile standard --no-tts --stt-backend parakeet-mlx --model-family gemma4 --gemma4-size e4b --vad-backend torch --no-mts --gain 1 --replay-speed 1 (all other settings at production defaults, final-aware partials on)
clip_selection: Same speech-dense offsets as the frozen 150 s clips (1290 s / 1170 s), extended to 360 s. Declared coverage floor 0.75: the best 360 s window anywhere in the 2_8_26 sermon reaches only 0.777, measured before any run; neither window has a 5 s no-speech interval with RMS > 0.15.

draft_g3.hypothesis: E2B OptiQ as mlx-lm draft (gamma=3) shortens the Gemma E4B translation tail on long finals (L2 text bench: -18..-23 % medium/long, byte-identical 21/21)
draft_g3.abort_rule: after its first run: peak Metal > 15.5 GiB or pageouts grew -> arm BLOCKED, not repeated

serial_finals.hypothesis: Not overlapping final STT(N) with Gemma translation(N-1) removes the Metal contention behind joint STT+translation tail finals

order: per clip: ctl,draft_g3,serial_finals | serial_finals,draft_g3,ctl | ctl,serial_finals,draft_g3 (3 repeats per configuration, controls at both ends, candidate order reversed in the middle repetition); clip A then clip B

gates.G1_primary: gemma-routed silence-final speech_end_to_final_ms nearest-rank p95 (pooled over 3 repeats per clip): arm <= 0.85*ctl or arm <= ctl-300 ms, on both clips
gates.G2: all-route silence-final p95 and pooled smart_cut+hard_cut p95 not worse than ctl + max(5 %,100 ms)
gates.G3: all-route silence-final p50 not worse than ctl + max(5 %,50 ms)
gates.G4_identity: >= 95 % byte-identical translated finals vs the same-repeat control run (aligned by row order); every difference listed
gates.G5_previews: preview count per run >= 98 % of the clip's mean control count
gates.G6_memory: draft_g3: peak Metal <= 15.5 GiB and no pageouts (absolute budget declared because the draft cannot pass the frozen relative guard); serial_finals: peak RSS/Metal <= max(control) + max(10 %,256 MiB)
gates.G7_health: rc 0, no timeout, lifecycle status recorded, chunk_count within +-10 % of the clip's mean control
gates.n: gemma-routed silence finals per arm >= 50 per clip and >= 100 across clips for p95_claim_eligible; otherwise a screen without p95 claim

outcome_rule: PASS only if every gate holds on both clips -> eligible for a later confirmation with visible ACKs (tools/overnight_bench.py); otherwise REJECTED naming the gate. No default changes and no combination arm follow from this screen.
excluded: every previously screened arm (overnight_screen_20260910 28 arms, standard/spanish/lite screens, MTP, Whisper-base) and any preview-suppression variant; latest_partial is the closest rejected arm to serial_finals and is not re-run.

amendments.what: draft_g3 abort/G6 pageout sub-rule: 'vm_stat pageouts grew during the run' replaced by 'pageout growth during a draft run exceeds max(5x the same clip's median control-run growth, 20000 pages)'
amendments.why: vm_stat pageouts are machine-wide, not process-specific: the first control run (no draft) already grew by 1877 pages, so the literal rule would block the arm on background noise. Peak Metal <= 15.5 GiB is unchanged.
amendments.effect: the in-progress first draft run (ts0911_A_draft_g3_r0) was stopped and discarded before completion; the screen resumed with the same order; ctl_r0 retained.
